title: Visit every item
summary: PowerShell: Visit every item. Count up to 4.
introduction: foreach runs its block for each value in a group. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
The range 1..3 supplies three values to the loop.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The loop variable holds one item, not the whole group.
